verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents a self-hosted option that runs the platform in your own infrastructure, so trace and operational data stay in your environment (docs-48, docs-17). That gives users control over where their data resides, but only by self-hosting. The evidence shows no choice of storage region or data residency within the managed cloud offering. Missing for 10: selectable cloud regions (e.g., US/EU) for SaaS data residency, residency documentation for the hosted service, and independent corroboration of self-hosted residency.
